stemMd: A site map has north at the top. A path runs 30 m east and then 40 m north. What is the straight-line distance from start to finish?
explanationMd: The displacement components form a right triangle. Its hypotenuse is√(30²+40²)=50 m. The route length is70 m, but the requested straight-line distance is shorter.

distractorRationale.d: This is the walked distance along the two segments.
distractorRationale.c: Subtracting perpendicular distances does not give displacement.
distractorRationale.a: Averaging distances does not give the diagonal.
